historical_significance: 希波克拉底（前460-前370），古希腊科斯岛医学家，被尊为‘医学之父’。他将医学从神秘主义和神灵崇拜转向理性观察和临床经验，奠定了临床医学的基础。希波克拉底学派编纂了《希波克拉底集》，提出了体液说，强调观察病人的症状、记录病程和自然恢复过程。他著名的誓言‘先勿伤害’体现了医伦的基石。他的方法强调医生的临床观察能力、病人的病史记录和对自然恢复的尊重，成为后世医学的基石。
historical_significance_en: Hippocrates (460-370 BCE), ancient Greek physician from the island of Kos, known as the 'Father of Medicine'. He transformed medicine from mysticism and divine worship to rational observation and clinical experience, founding clinical medicine. The Hippocratic Corpus was compiled by the Hippocratic School, proposing the humoral theory, emphasizing observation of patient symptoms, recording disease courses and natural recovery processes. His famous oath 'First do no harm' embodies the cornerstone of medical ethics. His methods emphasize the physician's clinical observation skills, patient medical history recording, and respect for natural recovery, becoming the cornerstone of subsequent medicine.
